[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding (bid your private value) is a dominant strategy for risk-neutral bidders because you pay the second-highest bid if you win. Other rational bidders will also bid their values. My private value is $28, so I will bid 28 to maximize expected profit and avoid overpaying.]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. Other rational bidders expect this and it remains optimal regardless of their beliefs.
